title: 3.2.19 Lab: Compose Two Functions
description: Write two returning functions, then feed one result into the other and log the chain. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Define the first function
steps.instructions: Define a function called double that takes one parameter n and returns n multiplied by 2.

steps.title: Define the second function
steps.instructions: Define a function called addTen that takes one parameter n and returns n plus 10.

steps.title: Compose them in one expression
steps.instructions: Call one function with the result of the other, for example addTen(double(5)). Because both return values, the inner call's result can be the outer call's argument.

steps.title: Log the chain and a reversed chain
steps.instructions: Use console.log to print the composed result. Then compose them in the opposite order and log that too, so you can see the answer change with the order.
